items.headline: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers
items.detail: Last month, a Claude user noticed his account was consuming tokens even though he wasn't working. Anthropic has since warned users about hackers.

items.headline: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
items.detail: Cognition's valuation multiple is higher than Cursor's was before selling to SpaceX.

items.headline: Sony isn’t phasing out discs quite as quickly as we thought
items.detail: Sony isn't backing away from its decision to kill the video game disc in January 2028. But Sony isn't shutting down production as quickly as we thought, either.

items.headline: Drama swirls around OpenAI’s legendary mathematical milestone
items.detail: OpenAI says it found a solution to a major math problem that has remained unsolved for around 90 years, as reported earlier by The New York Times and Wired.

items.headline: How one hedge-fund manager built his firm to be powered entirely by AI agents
items.detail: It's a stark example of a growing reality on Wall Street as firms test the benefits and limits of AI in finance and on their employees.

items.headline: Meta pushes into personal AI agents as company faces public reckoning over privacy and safety
items.detail: Meta unveiled its Muse personal agent app that comes in a free tier or a monthly subscription costing $20 or $100 depending on usage.

items.headline: OpenAI says it cracked 90-year-old maths problem in 88 hours
items.detail: OpenAI's claim that it solved parts of Navier-Stokes equations has quickly stirred controversy.

items.headline: New law to force tech firms to stop children taking or sharing nude images
items.detail: The government said it will legislate "as soon as they can" but may "reassess" its plans if firms make the desired changes sooner.

items.headline: Chinese AI firms Z.ai and MiniMax could remain loss-making until 2030, Macquarie says
items.detail: Chinese artificial intelligence companies Z.ai and MiniMax could remain loss-making through 2030 even as their revenues surge, underscoring the enormous cost of competing at the technological frontier, according to Macquarie Group’s head…
